dedupe_keys.name: three years of hourly data from 3 021 smart heat meters in danish residential buildings

description: This data set gives three years of cleaned hourly data from 3,021 commercial smart heat meters in Danish residential buildings served by district heating. It was published on Zenodo in May 2022 and updated in February 2023 (version 1.1.0) by Markus Schaffer, Torben Tvedebrink and Anna Marszal-Pomianowska, with a data descriptor in Scientific Data, with funding from the Independent Research Fund Denmark and the EU PRELUDE project. The data were screened, interpolated to equal steps and gap-filled with a weighted moving average scaled to follow the cumulative meter trend; the anonymised raw data of 3,127 meters are included for transparency. Context for each building gives construction year, building type and, where available, energy label, linked by meter ID, and a PDF describes every column. Coverage is residential buildings in Denmark. The data are a zipped archive of about 3.3 GB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the location is anonymised and the gap-filling changes raw values. Simulation uses are building-level heat demand modelling, low-temperature district heating planning and fault detection. Related records: data-denmark-dma-hourly-district-heating-demand gives area-level Danish demand.
